# Thesaurus.com

> > The world's largest online thesaurus providing comprehensive synonyms, antonyms, and word definitions to enhance vocabulary and writing.

Thesaurus.com is a comprehensive word reference platform offering extensive synonym and antonym entries, writing guides, and grammar resources. The site serves as a primary vocabulary-building tool alongside its parent company Dictionary.com, helping users improve their writing through accurate word choices and linguistic understanding.

- synonyms

## Core Thesaurus Entries

- [Thesaurus.com Homepage](https://www.thesaurus.com): World's largest online thesaurus for synonyms and antonyms.
- [GET Synonyms & Antonyms](https://www.thesaurus.com/browse/get): Word entry for GET verb with 404 synonyms, antonyms, and examples.
- [DRY Synonyms & Antonyms](https://www.thesaurus.com/browse/dry): Word entry for DRY with 200 synonyms, antonyms, and related words.
- [ENEMY Synonyms & Antonyms](https://www.thesaurus.com/browse/enemy): Word entry for ENEMY with 72 synonyms, antonyms, and example sentences.
- [SELFISH Synonyms & Antonyms](https://www.thesaurus.com/browse/selfish): Word entry for SELFISH with 64 synonyms, antonyms, and usage examples.
- [CITY Synonyms & Antonyms](https://www.thesaurus.com/browse/city): Word entry for CITY with 36 synonyms, antonyms, and related terminology.
- [WRONGLY Synonyms & Antonyms](https://www.thesaurus.com/browse/wrongly): Word entry for WRONGLY adverb with 27 synonyms and antonyms.
- [BRAVELY Synonyms & Antonyms](https://www.thesaurus.com/browse/bravely): Word entry for BRAVELY adverb with 18 synonyms and antonyms.
- [Browse Words by Alphabetical Index](https://www.thesaurus.com/list): Alphabetical browse index for words starting with numerals and diacritics.

## Writing & Grammar Guides

- [Writing Tips & Expert Articles](https://www.thesaurus.com/articles): Expert articles on writing, grammar, vocabulary, and literary techniques.
- [Independent vs. Dependent Clauses](https://www.thesaurus.com/articles/independent-vs-dependent-clause): Grammar guide explaining independent and dependent clauses in sentence structure.
- [Ampersands: Usage & Punctuation Rules](https://www.thesaurus.com/articles/ampersand): Punctuation guide on ampersand usage in formal and informal writing.
- [Shades of Green: Etymology & Word Origins](https://www.thesaurus.com/articles/shades-of-green-where-we-got-these-colorful-words): Etymology and history of green color words and their linguistic origins.
